steps.command: cat /app/my-sql-query.sql; echo "---"; sqlite3 /app/oewn.sqlite ".tables"; echo "---"; sqlite3 /app/oewn.sqlite ".schema"

cd /app; sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "SELECT name, tbl_name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='index';"; echo "---counts"; sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM words),(SELECT count(*) FROM senses),(SELECT count(*) FROM synsets);"

cd /app; time sqlite3 oewn.sqlite < my-sql-query.sql > /tmp/orig.out; wc -l /tmp/orig.out; head /tmp/orig.out

cd /app; sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "SELECT count(*), count(DISTINCT synsetid) FROM synsets; SELECT count(*), count(DISTINCT wordid) FROM words; SELECT count(*), count(DISTINCT wordid||','||synsetid) FROM senses;"
cd /app; sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "SELECT count(*) FROM senses s LEFT JOIN synsets syn ON s.synsetid=syn.synsetid WHERE syn.synsetid IS NULL;"

cat > /tmp/candidate.sql <<'EOF'
WITH synset_counts AS (
  SELECT s.wordid AS wordid, s.synsetid AS synsetid,
         COUNT(*) AS sense_count,
         syn.domainid AS domainid,
         syn.posid AS posid
  FROM senses s
  JOIN synsets syn ON syn.synsetid = s.synsetid
  GROUP BY s.wordid, s.synsetid, syn.domainid, syn.posid
),
word_stats AS (
  SELECT wordid,
         COUNT(*) AS total_synsets,
         SUM(sense_count) AS total_senses,
         COUNT(DISTINCT domainid) AS distinct_domains,
         COUNT(DISTINCT posid) AS distinct_posids
  FROM synset_counts
  GROUP BY wordid
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT domainid) >= 2 AND SUM(sense_count) >= 2
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT wordid, synsetid, sense_count,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wordid ORDER BY sense_count DESC, synsetid ASC) AS rn
  FROM synset_counts
)
SELECT w.wordid AS word_id, w.word AS word,
       ws.total_synsets, ws.total_senses, ws.distinct_domains, ws.distinct_posids,
       r.synsetid AS top_synsetid, r.sense_count AS top_synset_sense_count
FROM word_stats ws
JOIN words w ON w.wordid = ws.wordid
JOIN ranked r ON r.wordid = ws.wordid AND r.rn = 1
ORDER BY ws.total_senses DESC, ws.total_synsets DESC, ws.distinct_domains DESC, w.wordid ASC
LIMIT 500;
EOF
cd /app; time sqlite3 oewn.sqlite < /tmp/candidate.sql > /tmp/cand.out; diff /tmp/orig.out /tmp/cand.out && echo MATCH
cd /app; sqlite3 oewn.sqlite "EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN $(tr '\n' ' ' < /tmp/candidate.sql)"
